profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Vice President) @ J.P. Morgan Chase
profile.summary: Deep-stack, full-stack engineer and serial entrepreneur with roots at Microsoft and JPMorgan Chase having a track record of building and scaling products across media, consumer and enterprise platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Vice President)
positions.description:
I am excited to be working at one of the largest financial institutions as a senior software engineer (VP) working on the next generation of technologies.

JP Morgan Chase is not a bank, it is a fintech!
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Kubernetes · Cloud Computing · Java · Software Development · Software Defined Networking

positions.title: Director Of Engineering
positions.description:
Responsible for architecting and building an hybrid-AI content generation platform that is currently syndicating sports content to the Associated Press, NASCAR, ESPN, and many other organizations.  Using a variety of technologies including AI to build a robust full-stack platform that is utilized 24/7 by many users.

Our proprietary technology has proven to save our customers both time and money, improve search results all the while producing professionally authored sports content.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Prompt Engineering · TypeScript · React.js · HTML · Scrum · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · Microsoft Azure · Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · ASP.NET Core · Microservices · PostgreSQL · Strategy

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maven.io is a coalition of mavens operating on a shared platform. I strive to improve the shared platform through pragmatic thought and skilled engineering.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Microsoft SQL Server · React.js · HTML · Scrum · Elasticsearch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · Microsoft Azure · Engineering Management · ASP.NET Core · Strategy · GitHub

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Chief Technology Officer & Co-founder

SkyMode is an entirely new approach to mobile e-commerce empowering enterprises and retailers with a powerful and flexible technology platform that enables consumers to purchase products with one touch on a mobile device. 

SkyMode’s One Touch Offers™ combines promotion and purchase in a frictionless experience allowing a retailer to communicate and immediately transact with their customers directly from their promotional content.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Scrum · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · javaee · Eclipse · Strategy

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Mobile Development Manager
positions.description: Back with Scout after a 3 year hiatus.  Overhauled everything about the website and streamlined all engineering processes.  Built, deployed, and managed the creation of Scout.com's official iOS native application.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: Architecting the iOS and Windows Phone 8 versions of the AT&T Messages and AT&T Addressbook applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Android · Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) · Web Services · iOS

positions.title: Senior Developer, Mobile Web Services
positions.description: Oversaw a team of engineers responsible for every Allrecipes’ mobile application.  This included the 10+ million installation base of the ‘DinnerSpinner’ and ‘Video Cookbook’ mobile applications on the iOS, Android, Windows Phone 7/8 and Windows 8 platforms.  Also responsible for the external web services RESTful API infrastructure consumed by a multitude of client applications.  In addition to the internal engineering team, I often worked with domestic and international development companies to facilitate the explosive growth of Allrecipes’ mobile presence.  Daily activities included end-to-end feature development along with app deployment to all popular mobile application stores.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Information Services (IIS) · Web Services · Agile Methodologies · C# · Lucene

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
First developer hired to build Scout.com website from the ground up.  Architected and designed majority of the site’s features.  A single codebase powers more than 400 distinct web sites visited by over 4 million unique monthly visitors generating millions of dollars in revenue.  I have a complete and thorough knowledge of website architecture which includes database schema, front-end web code, middle-layer services, e-commerce workflow, and premium content authentication.  I architected all e-commerce features which utilize the latest cryptographic technologies.

Daily responsibilities include management of a small group of software engineers, collaboration with product management, network operations group and test team to ensure that product change requests are implemented and released on schedule.  Reliability and performance of the website is also paramount to my job.  

Scout.com was one of the early web sites to implement a "pay wall" for its content.  Scout.com is consider one of the top two Football and Basketball Recruiting web sites in the United States.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET · HTML · Web Services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
One of the first software developers to be hired at Rivals.com.  Responsible for the software architecture of the website and other internal technologies.  Unfortunately, the company was not able to survive the dot com bust and went out of business in April 2001.

NOTE: The Rivals.com that was founded in Nashville and later sold to Yahoo was run by a different group of individuals. They purchased the IP during Rival Network's liquidation proceedings.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · Web Services · C#

positions.title: Web Design Engineer Level 3
positions.description: Contract Internet and SQL database programmer.  Worked on web-based e-mail project, web calendar project, and top web developer for MSN.com.  Developed the current MSN.com backend content management tool.  In addition to supporting the U.S. site (10 million daily users), it supports 26 localized versions of MSN.com web site.  Daily skills used include transact-SQL, ASP/VBScript, JavaScript, HTML, and DHTML using a variety of popular development applications and tools, primary Visual Studio 98.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · ASP.NET · HTML · Cache Management · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Director of Client Development
positions.description: Promoted from a contract computer programmer after 7 months.  Responsibilities included maintaining a professional relationship with all clients, which include Boeing, Microsoft, and Deloitte & Touche, LLP.  Managed a team of Microsoft Certified Professionals for network installations and troubleshooting.  Over saw the advanced technology research which included Internet / Intranet, client/server, and software development technologies.  Developed advanced Intranets/Extranets/Internet utilizing VB 5.0, .ASP, SQL Server, and other Microsoft Technologies.  Conducted presentations for advanced technology topics such as ActiveX, E-Commerce, and project management.

positions.title: Student Computer Assistant
positions.description: Responsibilities included maintaining a Windows NT 3.51 server, Novell NetWare 3.12 server, e-mail gateway, and over 50 networked PCs running Windows 95 and 3.x.  Implemented an electronic evaluation form using Teleform 4.0 and MS-Access 95 and developed a grade reporting program using VB 4.0 and SQL Server 6.0.

positions.title: System Administration Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for the administration, planning, and implementation of NetWare 3.12 computer network connecting PCs and Macintoshes. Dealt with issues of internal support through personal instruction and documentation.

positions.title: Assistant System Administrator
positions.description: Responsible for the administration of a 90 computer network which included 50 PCs, Novell NetWare 3.1x server, and a variety of UNIX platforms. (I.e. HP-UX, IBM AIX, DEC OSF, DG-UX).  Network topology setup and maintenance.  Responsibilities also included computer hardware/software purchases, implementation of a hardware/software inventory using MS-Access, IP subnet addressing, and 10-baseT patch-panel maintenance
